post0.content: Este es el primer post de la página. Aquí voy a publicar notas sobre econometría, datos y economía costarricense. . Las fórmulas se escriben con LaTeX, por ejemplo $ Delta y_t = alpha beta’ y_{t-1} + varepsilon_t$. . Para escribir un post nuevo: . En Markdown: creá un archivo _posts/AAAA-MM-DD-titulo.md con un encabezado como el de este archivo. | Como notebook: poné un .ipynb en _notebooks/ con el nombre AAAA-MM-DD-titulo.ipynb. Hay una plantilla en _templates/. | .

page1.title: About
page1.content: . I’m a final-year Economics student at the University of Costa Rica. I’m interested in econometrics, data science, data journalism and finance, especially when they’re applied to concrete problems in the Costa Rican economy. . I currently work as a research assistant at Doble Check, the University of Costa Rica’s fact-checking project, where I verify public claims about the economy and public finances using official data. . Previously, I interned at CINDE in the Research, Monitoring & Evaluation area, and spent an exchange semester at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, where I earned honors in Machine Learning. . My undergraduate thesis studies exchange rate dynamics in Costa Rica using nonlinear error-correction models (TVECM) applied to the MONEX foreign exchange market. . Here I write about econometrics, data and the Costa Rican economy. .
